name: Plain O20 3R at the lead's seats, no knuckle or drive, with a one-sided arm-arc relay doing K's job (the relay's simplicity column)
verdict: DEAD (pre-registered kill above 17.5): frozen exact Bench(110,360) 26.42 (near-touch 27.53, chain-only in-band reading 30.6) vs the lead's 18.28 and champion 75.94; fast Bench(60,160) best 18.45 (near-touch 19.55; plain best 16.64) vs the lead's fast 12.50. The relay KINEMATICS are worth the lead's K and more (ideal relay, no hardware: 3.53 fast / 10.22 frozen exact at PHI 75, psi2 -14), but an arm-fixed circular arc long enough to do K's job (PHI 45-75) wraps onto the medial arm and meets the TORSO at phi = 0 (across the body, plane 135-150, and arm-at-side axial rotation: track up to -10.1 mm into the chest); the converged optimum therefore keeps PHI ~19 where the relay does little (ideal at that arc 17.27 fast) and pays the knee stack's 5.4-5.9 mm lift onto the carriage. 4 counted joints, complexity 29.0 vs the lead's 18.5.
limiter: the arm-fixed relay arc's length vs the torso: at the only low-lift axis family (tilt ~12 toward taz ~237, lift 5.4-5.9 mm) the arc must turn toward the medial arm (sgn -1 is kinematically wrong: ideal PHI 60 sgn -1 44.31 fast), and at PHI 45 (arc 70 deg, 93 mm) 9 of 14 fast contacts are the un-relayed track in the chest (plane 135-150 elev 15-75 axial -45..-60: -0.5 to -10.1 mm, 7 of 8 below -7; arm at side axial 60-120: -5.6 mm); PHI 19 avoids the torso but leaves 103/360 fold losses frozen; lift costs the chain 0.04-0.07 in-band (chain-only 0.847-0.865)
note: Convergence gate (near-touch objective, 387 relay-hardware configurations on Bench(60,160) fast, local ES + axis scan; farm closed): gain over the second half 0.425 pts, over the last third 0.425 pts, top-5 spread 0.193 pts -> PASSED (plain gap: 1.058 / 1.058 / 0.451). Kit reproduction of nok_metal exact (+30 54/10/1/44, +45 68/15/1/53, +60 83/15/1/68 relayed/collide/contact/clean) but the kit's q 1.0 metal parks hub 2 171 mm from GH, so the score comes from the lead's own model with K welded (smhi 5 + |dK| <= 0.1 gate), drive metal deleted, hub K + link 1a/1b kept as metal (first pass), relay solve / metal / lift / jams from armarc-relay-knuckle-4r. The folded-side hub-1 collisions of the kit become 1-4 'parts' poses in the lead's metal. Window shift psi2 (J2 rest axis about J1) alone: welded 3R control 39.80 -> 28.87-31.83 fast at psi2 -9 (a2 61.8-62.1). Frozen wear is of the es3 best (k 197), the converged best (k 381) is within 1.1 fast points of it. Continuity flood not run (dead before it matters: the flood can only drop relayed poses).
